source: Completed remote campaign results.json files; aggregate scores only
scoring: Shared lexical WER: lowercase/NFKD, combining-mark removal, symbol normalization retaining apostrophes, whitespace collapse
comparison_notes: Repeated benchmarks, not fresh blind tests.
Older historical metrics use a separate evaluation contract and must not be spliced into these tables.
ATCO2 recording-disjoint view excludes 213 known Jacktol-linked segments; it is not proof of complete cross-corpus isolation.

recipe.selection_policy: val_wer on Gold development only; all six models freeze before test scoring
comparison_caveats: Parent uses known-safe Nemotron 90-second nominal global duration batching, not Parakeet OOM buckets.
Parent selection uses only frozen Gold development, not the earlier larger development set.
Gold optimizer, source pools, weights, steps, seeds and augmentations mirror G1-G4; native preprocessing retained.
Gold duration limit 17s matches historical implementation; excluded hours are explicitly audited.
Existing community test is a fixed comparison benchmark, not a newly blind holdout.
